column1: # Valid supplied headwords whose entire row was misaligned; original editorial replacement entries.
abundance|/əˈbʌndəns/|noun|豐富；充裕|The region has an abundance of natural resources.|這個地區擁有豐富的天然資源。
anticipate|/ænˈtɪsɪpeɪt/|verb|預期；預料|We anticipate an increase in demand.|我們預期需求將增加。
content|/ˈkɒntent/|noun|內容|The content of the report is useful.|這份報告的內容很有用。
cute|/kjuːt/|adjective|可愛的|The child drew a cute little bird.|這個孩子畫了一隻可愛的小鳥。
differently|/ˈdɪfərəntli/|adverb|不同地；以不同方式|People may interpret the same message differently.|人們可能以不同方式解讀同一則訊息。
during|/ˈdjʊərɪŋ/|preposition|在……期間|Please turn off your phone during the examination.|考試期間請關閉手機。
elderly|/ˈeldəli/|adjective|年長的；年老的|The centre provides services for elderly people.|這個中心為年長者提供服務。
entail|/ɪnˈteɪl/|verb|必須涉及；需要|The work will entail frequent travel.|這份工作需要經常出差。
exhibition|/ˌeksɪˈbɪʃən/|noun|展覽|The exhibition features paintings by local artists.|這場展覽展出當地藝術家的畫作。
firstly|/ˈfɜːstli/|adverb|首先|Firstly, check that all the equipment is working.|首先，確認所有設備都能運作。
formerly|/ˈfɔːməli/|adverb|以前；從前|The building was formerly a hospital.|這棟建築物以前是一所醫院。
frontier|/ˈfrʌntɪə(r)/|noun|邊境；前沿|They built a road near the frontier.|他們在邊境附近修築了一條道路。
help|/help/|verb|幫助|The diagram will help you understand the circuit.|這張圖將幫助你理解電路。
i.e.|/ˌaɪ ˈiː/|abbreviation|也就是；即|The course is free, i.e. you do not have to pay.|這門課程免費，也就是說你不必付費。
journalist|/ˈdʒɜːnəlɪst/|noun|新聞記者|The journalist interviewed several witnesses.|這位記者訪問了幾位目擊者。
located|/ləʊˈkeɪtɪd/|adjective|位於……的|The library is located near the station.|圖書館位於車站附近。
once|/wʌns/|adverb|一次；曾經|I visit the library once a week.|我每週去圖書館一次。
preferably|/ˈprefərəbli/|adverb|最好；更可取地|Please arrive early, preferably before nine.|請提早到達，最好在九點之前。
presently|/ˈprezəntli/|adverb|目前；不久|The building is presently closed for repairs.|這棟建築物目前因維修而關閉。
pronounced|/prəˈnaʊnst/|adjective|明顯的；顯著的|There is a pronounced difference between the two results.|這兩個結果之間有明顯差異。
task|/tɑːsk/|noun|任務；工作|Your first task is to check the data.|你的第一項任務是檢查資料。
technique|/tekˈniːk/|noun|技巧；技術方法|The new technique improves image quality.|這項新技術方法改善了影像品質。
translator|/trænzˈleɪtə(r)/|noun|譯者；翻譯人員|The translator checked every sentence carefully.|這位譯者仔細檢查了每個句子。
ultrasound|/ˈʌltrəsaʊnd/|noun|超音波；超音波檢查|The doctor used ultrasound to examine the organ.|醫師利用超音波檢查器官。
VAT|/ˌviː eɪ ˈtiː/|noun|加值稅（value added tax 的縮寫）|The price includes VAT.|這個價格包含加值稅。
vocabulary|/vəˈkæbjələri/|noun|詞彙；詞彙量|Reading regularly can improve your vocabulary.|經常閱讀可以增加你的詞彙量。
